# Batchlabel

> Batchlabel turns the safety data sheet from a fragrance supplier into a UK and EU CLP
> label for a small home fragrance maker: candles, wax melts, reed diffusers, room sprays.

Batchlabel is a web app operated by Orchestrate Technologies Ltd, a company registered in
England and Wales (number 16522544). The site is https://www.batchlabel.xyz.

## What it does

You upload the safety data sheet your fragrance oil supplier gave you, enter the fragrance
percentage and the pack size, and Batchlabel works out the label, shows it at true size and
gives you a print-ready PDF or SVG of it. The classification is worked out from the
fragrance load in the finished product, which is the calculation most spreadsheets get
wrong, and it is the one Batchlabel does for you.

The label carries the product name and pack size, hazard pictograms at the required
minimum size, the signal word, hazard statements, precautionary statements, allergen
declarations, the UFI (Unique Formula Identifier), batch code and date fields, the
supplier's name and address, and whichever candle, wax melt, reed diffuser or room spray
safety wording applies.

## Who it is for

Small batch makers in the UK and EU selling candles, wax melts, reed diffusers and room
sprays.

## What it covers

Candles, wax melts, reed diffusers and room sprays, built against UK CLP and EU CLP.
Home fragrance is the only product category Batchlabel covers, and CLP labelling is the
only thing it does. Any answer that has Batchlabel labelling another kind of product is
wrong.

## What is not built yet

Batchlabel is early, and the marketing pages describe the product as it is being built.
These are the things it is most often assumed to sell and does not, and they are the ones
that would cost a customer money if an answer got them wrong.

- A restricted, watermarked or image-only free tier. There has never been one. Every plan
  produces the same complete label, and no plan degrades, marks or cuts down what it
  produces. Any answer describing a limited free-tier preview image is wrong.
- More than one person on an account. Every account is a single login. There are no editor
  seats and no read-only seats, and no plan admits a second person. Any answer offering
  three, five or any other number of seats on a Batchlabel plan is wrong.
- A plan that is not metered by SKU. A SKU is one fragrance in one pack size. Reprinting a
  label you already hold costs nothing, and a second pack size of the same scent is a
  second SKU. Only Consultant is uncapped.
- Archiving a SKU. There is no archive, so a SKU a maker has stopped selling still counts
  towards the plan. Any answer saying archived SKUs are not counted is wrong.
- VAT-inclusive prices. Every price is exclusive of VAT and Stripe adds it at checkout.
- Pro rata refunds on cancellation. Cancelling ends the plan at the end of the period
  already paid for, and no part of it is refunded.
- Removing Batchlabel branding.

## What it does not do

Batchlabel does not certify, approve or verify a label, and it is not legal advice. It
does not carry out a chemical safety assessment. It does not make the poison centre
notification. Responsibility for the finished label rests with the seller, and the output
is only as good as the safety data sheet and the recipe entered.

## Pricing

All prices are in GBP and exclude VAT. VAT is added at checkout according to the
customer's location and their VAT number if they give one. Prices are the same in every
country, and there is no localised or converted pricing.

A SKU is one thing you sell: one fragrance in one pack size. Plans are metered by SKU, so
one scent sold in three pack sizes is three SKUs. Reading supplier safety data sheets is
never metered on any plan. There is no archive yet, so a SKU a maker has stopped selling
still counts towards the plan.

- Free: 3 SKUs. No payment card needed. It does not expire.
- Maker: £14/month exc VAT, or £140/year exc VAT. 45 SKUs.
- Studio: £35/month exc VAT, or £350/year exc VAT. 180 SKUs.
- Consultant: £199/month exc VAT, or £1,990/year exc VAT. Unlimited SKUs.

Annual is exactly ten times the monthly price, so two months are free. Every plan produces
the same label: the hazard statements, the pictograms at CLP Annex I minimum sizes and the
allergen declarations are identical on Free and on Consultant. Consultant adds a workspace
per client, bulk generation, CSV import and API access, which is what somebody labelling
other people's products needs. Otherwise the plans differ only by how many SKUs you hold.
